generator.params.bud_area.note: The leaf area its `bud` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows: the bud is now its flower closed, where before it drew the fruit ovoid.

appearance.organs.bud.colour.note: The buds are the closed flower, long and nodding, green when young and yellow-orange just before they open: about sRGB (95, 125, 75) to (225, 168, 35); drawn at the middle, about sRGB (153, 145, 51) (observations 296534068, 373697814).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Lilium columbianum: stems 60 cm to 1.2 m tall. The scan's text reads cm, which the plant's own parts show is a misreading of dm. The typical value is the one the plant was drawn at before, inside the source's range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Lilium columbianum: leaves 5 cm to 10 cm long.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams, Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States vol. 1 (1923), Lilium columbianum: leaves in whorls, the uppermost and lowest ones scattered.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), Lilium columbianum: whorls of 5 to 9 leaves, sometimes more; 6 is the count this spec drew by hand before, within that range.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a lily with whorls of narrow leaves up a single stem and nodding orange flowers spotted maroon, their petals swept back. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1 m tall at 8 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: mid-green leaves; orange flowers. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): six orange tepals in two whorls, six stamens and a superior pistil of three carpels, from the characters of Liliaceae by the rules at the flowering plants.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

generator.params.bud_spacing.note: The buds nod on long stalks spread like the open flowers' along the upper stem, not crowded at the tip: spaced as the flowers are (flowering photographs, observations 336315881, 372788972, 170783016, 285649204, 373697814, 296534068, 1527310, 368260500): a bud's internode as a share of a flower's, judged by eye.
